marc:datafield.marc:subfield: 誇大不實的醫療迷思 : 醫師教您如何分辨虛與實 | Kua da bu shi de yi liao mi si : yi shi jiao nin ru he fen bian xu yu shi

Every day, various health-related messages come to us through the internet, media, and Line, telling us how to eat, how to detox, how to exercise, and how to take medicine in order to live healthier, longer, younger, and slimmer lives. However, many of these messages are filled with misinformation and myths. Dr. Nina Shapiro, with over twenty years of experience, has been helping patients make important health decisions every day. In this book, she combines the most valuable medical research findings with personal stories from her experience, aiming to debunk widespread medical myths and misunderstandings, and to provide practical health strategies that anyone can follow
